preconditions.description: The input contains exactly E + 1 lines: the first line with N and E, followed by E lines describing roads.
The number of cities N and roads E are within the specified constraints.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N and a != b for a, b in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range [1, N].
There are no duplicate roads in the exact same direction in the input.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by exactly E lines representing the reoriented roads.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'NO' or all(any((a, b) == (u, v) or (a, b) == (v, u) for u, v in input_roads) for a, b in output_roads)
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, every output road corresponds to an input road, either keeping its original direction or reversing it.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'NO' or (all(in_degree[v] == 1 and out_degree[v] == 1 for v in range(1, N + 1)) and is_strongly_connected(output_roads, N))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the resulting graph is a single cycle visiting every city exactly once (Eulerian circuit on N nodes), meaning every node has in-degree 1 and out-degree 1, and the graph is strongly connected.
If 'YES' is printed, the number of output roads equals the number of input roads.
